messages.meta.title: D-CAS ENTERPRISE LABS
messages.brand.subtitle: Corporate competency & talent strategy dashboard
messages.sidebar.notice: Review company criteria and role evidence in one place.
messages.nav.label: Dashboard navigation
messages.overview.title: Talent portfolio summary
messages.overview.subtitle: Review the current status against the company talent model, job criteria and internal success profiles.
messages.model.title: Company talent & role models
messages.model.subtitle: Define multiple ways to succeed for each job, rather than a single average profile, and manage them by version.
messages.hiring.title: Hiring candidate analysis
messages.hiring.subtitle: Compare evidence for the applied job, alternative jobs and role pathways rather than ranking candidates by total score.
messages.benchmark.title: Current employee reference profiles
messages.benchmark.subtitle: Compare candidates with job and role groups whose work performance has been validated, noting similarities and differences.
messages.individual.title: Individual D-CAS results & job/role review
messages.individual.subtitle: Review D-CAS results, the actual applied job from the recruiting system and the company competency model together, while keeping each source distinct.
messages.development.title: 30/60/90-day development plan
messages.development.subtitle: A draft action plan for new-hire onboarding and current employee development.
messages.organization.title: Organizational capabilities & gaps
messages.organization.subtitle: Review the talent mix by job, role balance and staffing priorities rather than individual rankings.
messages.actions.title: Review & action plan
messages.actions.subtitle: Track interview checks, work-sample assessments, alternative job reviews and decisions by the responsible reviewers.
messages.settings.title: Data & access
messages.settings.subtitle: Review report connections, model versions, role-based access and activity history.
messages.metric.analyzedMeta: Candidates and employees in the current cycle
messages.metric.priorityMeta: Candidates with sufficient evidence of fit
messages.metric.leaderMeta: Further interviews and work-sample assessments required
messages.metric.gapsMeta: Priority job families for hiring and development
messages.panel.roleReadinessHelp: Group distribution distinguishing current readiness from development potential
messages.panel.capabilityHelp: Group averages across four domains, not individual ratings.
messages.panel.insightsHelp: Action items derived from the model and workforce composition
messages.flow.matchTitle: Review evidence of job and role fit
messages.flow.matchText: Compare the company model with multiple internal success profiles.
messages.flow.verifyTitle: Verify through interviews and work samples
messages.flow.verifyText: Review unverified behavioral competencies using structured questions and work samples.
messages.flow.humanText: Do not finalize hiring, placement or leadership selection based on assessment results alone.
messages.insight.leaderText: Consider execution-focused leadership profiles alongside strategic planning profiles.
messages.insight.specialistText: There is a sufficient pool of specialist-focused candidates in data and research roles.
messages.insight.gapText: Consider hiring and internal job transitions together.
messages.model.bannerTitle: Multiple success profiles, not one ideal
messages.model.bannerText: Identify distinct ways of succeeding among current employee groups with verified performance, and use these profiles to compare candidates.
messages.model.referenceTableHelp: Shows the role-based talent profiles and core strength patterns the company manages together.
messages.profile.strategyLeaderText: Integrates complex information and sets goals and priorities
messages.profile.projectLeadText: Turns plans into schedules and collaborative tasks and coordinates delivery
messages.profile.expertText: Provides expert judgment through deep focus and evidence-based analysis
messages.profile.operatorText: Completes work consistently while maintaining process and quality
messages.hiring.tableHelp: Compare match rates for the actual applied job and D-CAS-recommended job families separately. Select a row to see all Top 5 recommendations and supporting evidence.
messages.benchmark.profileHelp: Do not assess leadership based on PASS scores alone.
messages.benchmark.qualityHelp: Limit automated recommendations when the sample or performance evidence is insufficient.
messages.benchmark.sampleText: Results from {count} validated employees were used.
messages.benchmark.outcomeText: Use multiple sources of performance evidence rather than a single manager's opinion.
messages.benchmark.versionText: Currently based on {version}; change history is retained.
messages.benchmark.talentFormulaHelp: Combines D-CAS results and verified work performance from current employees in the same job.
messages.benchmark.talentFormulaNote: Keep job-specific samples and different ways of succeeding instead of one company-wide ideal.
messages.benchmark.performanceTableHelp: Company talent-profile references combining employee D-CAS, performance and role evidence with weights.
messages.benchmark.resultOnlyHelp: Explore job-related potential from results alone when work-performance data is unavailable.
messages.benchmark.resultOnlyStep1Text: Use the D-CAS Top 5 and matching signals.
messages.benchmark.resultOnlyStep2Text: Without actual performance, do not combine this with company talent-profile fit.
messages.benchmark.resultOnlyDisclaimerTitle: This does not confirm a high performer.
messages.benchmark.resultOnlyDisclaimer: Results alone cannot establish actual job excellence. Mark as a potential-fit candidate and verify with interviews, work samples and experience.
messages.benchmark.resultOnlyTableHelp: Top recommended job and signal from the report only; no performance score is included.
messages.individual.sourceApplication: Actual applied job · Recruiting system / staff
messages.individual.jobRequired: An applied job or a job selected for review by the responsible staff member is required to calculate job and role fit.
messages.individual.passTitle: Results across the four PASS domains
messages.individual.passHelp: Summary values from the original report, shown separately from company model calculations.
messages.individual.roleHelp: Distinguish current readiness from future potential when interpreting these signals.
messages.individual.topJobsHelp: Job-family recommendations and match rates from the D-CAS report, shown separately from resume-based matching.
messages.individual.resultSummaryHelp: Shows report identifiers and leading domains from the source result data.
messages.individual.resultSummaryText: Leading domains are {first} ({firstScore}) and {second} ({secondScore}). Review experience and interview evidence as well as these scores.
messages.individual.resumeHelp: Compare career and skill evidence from the resume separately from D-CAS recommendations.
messages.individual.resumePrivacy: In this demo, only the file name is stored in this browser.
messages.individual.resumeMatchHelp: Evidence identified from experience, skills, and projects. Calculated separately from D-CAS results.
messages.individual.resumeMatchEmpty: Connect a resume to show experience- and skill-based job-family recommendations and match rates.
messages.individual.evidenceHelp: Distinguish observed signals from items to verify in the interview.
messages.individual.interviewHelp: Apply the same criteria and rating scales to all candidates.
messages.individual.disclaimerTitle: Human review is required before final HR decisions.
messages.individual.disclaimer: This analysis is a job-related reference. Assessment results alone must not determine hiring, rejection, placement, promotion, or leadership selection.
messages.interview.q1: Describe a situation in which you prioritized conflicting goals and revised your plan.
messages.interview.q2: Describe in detail how you persuaded colleagues with different views or reached agreement.
messages.interview.q3: Explain how you made a decision with incomplete information and reviewed the outcome.
messages.development.priorityHelp: Suggest experiences needed for the target role, rather than focusing on correcting low scores.
messages.development.workStyleHelp: Connect individual strengths to practical ways of working.
messages.organization.rolesMeta: Jobs registered in the current model
messages.organization.coveredMeta: Current coverage meets or exceeds the target
messages.organization.coverageHelp: Compare the current workforce composition with company targets.
messages.organization.balanceHelp: Proportions across leadership, specialist, and practitioner tracks
messages.organization.privacyText: Statistics for groups of fewer than {count} people are not displayed to reduce the risk of identifying individuals.
messages.actions.tableHelp: Record interviews, work-sample assessments, and staff judgments following the assessment results.
messages.settings.integrationHelp: A dedicated adapter separates the UI from external result data.
messages.settings.accessHelp: Limit access to the minimum information needed for each role.
messages.settings.governanceHelp: Manage access history, retention periods, and human review.
messages.settings.i18nHelp: Keep the current screen and selections when changing languages.
messages.settings.requestText: Detailed reports are provided to authorized company staff. Assessment participants can use the existing privacy inquiry channel to request access to or correction of their personal information and an explanation of how their results are used.
messages.table.subject: Subject
messages.evidence.planning: A signal of structured prioritization across multiple goals was identified.
messages.evidence.integration: A strength in integrating information to understand the overall direction was observed.
messages.evidence.valueFit: Responses provide evidence consistent with examples of the company's core values.
messages.evidence.focus: A strength in retaining key information from complex material was observed.
messages.evidence.analysis: An analytical pattern of comparing evidence to form judgments was identified.
messages.evidence.consistency: Shows a tendency to apply procedures and quality standards consistently.
messages.evidence.execution: A strength in turning plans into step-by-step tasks was observed.
messages.evidence.sequence: A signal of managing task sequences and dependencies was identified.
messages.evidence.coordination: Aligns with roles that coordinate progress across multiple tasks.
messages.evidence.empathy: Responses provide evidence of considering other people's perspectives.
messages.verify.conflict: Conflict-resolution behavior requires further verification in the interview.
messages.verify.peopleLeadership: Actual experience leading people and approaches to giving feedback have not been verified.
messages.verify.communication: Use a work sample to assess the ability to communicate analysis to non-specialists.
messages.verify.ambiguity: Check decision-making speed in ambiguous situations.
messages.verify.sales: More behavioral evidence is needed on persuading customers and working under pressure to meet targets.
messages.verify.priority: Check responses to sudden changes in priorities.
messages.verify.dataMissing: Judgment was deferred because some result data is missing.
messages.verify.execution: Verify examples of turning ideas into deliverables and meeting deadlines.
messages.workStyle.autonomy: An environment that allows independent planning with clear goals and authority
messages.workStyle.bigPicture: A way of working that shares the broader context and long-term goals first
messages.workStyle.deepWork: Focused time for in-depth analysis with fewer interruptions
messages.workStyle.evidence: An environment with clear decision criteria and data access
messages.workStyle.structure: A project environment with transparent roles, schedules, and dependencies
messages.workStyle.collaboration: A collaborative approach with regular progress coordination
messages.workStyle.people: An environment that enables direct engagement with stakeholders to understand and reconcile their perspectives
messages.priority.delegation: Experience delegating tasks and checking progress
messages.priority.execution: Experience translating strategy into short execution cycles
messages.priority.communication: Experience explaining analytical findings in concise business terms
messages.priority.influence: Experience persuading stakeholders without formal authority
messages.priority.speed: Experience making timely decisions with limited information
messages.priority.salesContext: Hands-on experience understanding customers and revenue flows
messages.priority.flexibility: Experience adapting quickly to changes in plans
messages.priority.evidence: Experience validating people-related judgments with data
messages.priority.followThrough: Experience tracking agreed actions through to deadlines
messages.priority.focus: Experience maintaining key priorities amid multiple requests
messages.development.day30a: Observe product strategy work and document the goals and priorities of a small planning assignment.
messages.development.day60a: Take responsibility for part of a cross-functional project and coordinate schedules and decisions.
messages.development.day90a: Reassess the leadership candidate track through project retrospectives and peer feedback.
messages.development.day30b: Learn the key data and quality standards, and complete one analytical assignment independently.
messages.development.day60b: Translate analytical findings into a business decision document and explain them.
messages.development.day90b: Review the specialist track and whether to expand project responsibilities.
messages.development.day30c: Observe sales operations and customer touchpoints, and learn standard procedures.
messages.development.day60c: Coordinate schedules and collaboration on a small operational improvement project.
messages.development.day90c: Reassess both the applied job and project management as an alternative.
messages.development.day30d: Review people operations data and stakeholder needs, and fill gaps in the result data.
messages.development.day60d: Complete a small employee experience improvement assignment from start to finish.
messages.development.day90d: Reassess the role path and placement based on evidence of actual work performance.
messages.overview.pipelineHelp: Shows applicants with available D-CAS results and those who need interview or work-sample checks.
messages.overview.tasksHelp: Tasks supporting further verification and placement decisions, rather than assessment scores alone.
messages.overview.task1Text: Give greater weight to work samples and line-manager interviews because the internal success sample is insufficient.
messages.overview.task2Text: Review candidate evidence again, distinguishing strategic leadership profiles from execution-focused leadership profiles.
messages.overview.task3Text: Exclude unlinked reports from selection decisions and track their reconnection status.
messages.model.weightsHelp: Combine job, values and work-sample evidence rather than relying on a single assessment, and adjust the model for each company.
messages.model.validationHelp: Check performance-group bias and sample quality before using the model in hiring.
messages.model.validation1Text: Use only samples for which tenure, work performance and role level have been reviewed together.
messages.model.validation2Text: Preserve different ways of succeeding rather than replicating one high-performing employee as the ideal.
messages.model.validation3Text: Review the model version, sample and predictive validity again when the organization or job changes.
messages.hiring.metricMatchedMeta: Applicant ID and test ID matched
messages.hiring.portfolioHelp: Review the role mix against hiring needs without treating leadership as the only form of excellence.
messages.hiring.guideHelp: Compare job- and role-relevant evidence instead of ranking candidates as high, medium or low.
messages.hiring.guide1Text: Do not directly rank total scores for candidates applying to different jobs.
messages.hiring.guide2Title: Separate current readiness from growth potential
messages.hiring.guide2Text: Assess immediate job readiness separately from signals of future growth as a leader or specialist.
messages.hiring.guide3Text: The reviewer makes the final decision when interview, work-sample and career evidence are consistent.
messages.benchmark.comparisonHelp: Profile similarity is an exploratory signal, not a criterion for finding identical people.
messages.individual.placementHelp: Compare leadership, project lead, specialist and practitioner roles separately.
messages.individual.placementPrimary: Review in depth as the first-choice role
messages.individual.placementSecondary: Verify through a project or probation period
messages.individual.placementExplore: Monitor as a future growth path
messages.development.goalsHelp: Review actual work behaviors and deliverables rather than training completion alone.
messages.development.goal1Text: Explain core workflows and success criteria in your own words and complete a small assignment.
messages.development.goal2Text: Document the plan, collaboration and results of assigned work for the interim review.
messages.development.goal3Text: Decide the next role by reviewing performance, peer feedback and the employee's preferences together.
messages.development.reviewHelp: Managers, HR and employees review the same evidence together rather than relying on a one-sided company evaluation.
messages.development.managerText: Record work opportunities, observable behaviors and feedback.
messages.development.hrText: Check the consistency of job criteria, evaluation bias and alternative placements.
messages.development.selfText: Share feedback on work experience, difficulties and desired development paths.
messages.organization.departmentHelp: Exclude small groups and review role candidate pools alongside job gaps.
messages.organization.successionHelp: Separate employees ready for immediate placement from those to review after further experience.
messages.organization.mobilityHelp: Use adjacent jobs that draw on related strengths to guide internal mobility and development.
messages.actions.stageHelp: Track additional validation and human review after the assessment report.
messages.actions.policyHelp: Check that reviewers do not misinterpret results or make automated decisions.
messages.actions.policy1Text: Record whether the indicators used relate to the actual job duties.
messages.actions.policy2Text: Review the assessment, structured interview, work sample and career evidence together.
messages.actions.policy3Text: The reviewer records the rationale for hiring, placement and development decisions, including alternatives considered.
messages.roster.title: Applicant roster and D-CAS result connection status
messages.roster.help: Match the applicant IDs provided by the recruiter with the applicant IDs or test IDs in the assessment results.
messages.roster.name: Recruitment process
messages.roster.step1: Recruiter links the applicant roster and applied jobs
messages.roster.step2: Match D-CAS results using applicant IDs and test IDs
messages.roster.step3: Review match rates for the applied job and Top 5 recommended jobs
messages.competency.title: Edit job competency model
messages.competency.subtitle: Define company-wide, job-specific and role-specific competencies and link them to actual evaluation evidence.
messages.competency.workflowText: Manage a structured model with behavioral criteria and verification methods, rather than free-form notes.
messages.competency.contextHelp: Select a department and job, then review the competency mix and total weight.
messages.competency.editorHelp: Enter the competency name, scope, target level, weight and verification method.
messages.competency.name: Competency name
messages.competency.namePlaceholder: e.g., problem solving, customer focus, execution
messages.competency.behaviorPlaceholder: Describe behaviors that can be observed in actual work.
messages.competency.previewHelp: The finalized model is referenced in candidate comparisons, interviews, placement and 30-, 60- and 90-day plans.
messages.performance.entryHelp: Enter existing employees’ work performance and role-behavior evidence by job. Only approved records are used in the company talent-profile analysis.
messages.performance.dcasReadonlyNote: The D-CAS job signal is loaded from the linked report and cannot be edited by a manager. Managers enter only work performance and role-behavior evidence.
messages.performance.analysisFormula: On approval, job averages and the performance-linked talent signal are recalculated using D-CAS {dcas}%, performance {performance}%, and role evidence {role}%.
messages.performance.savedDraft: The values were saved as a draft and are not yet included in the analysis.
messages.performance.applied: The values were approved and the job-level company talent analysis was recalculated.
messages.performance.saveFailed: Could not save. Check the server connection and permissions.
messages.demo.disclosureTitle: All figures on this screen are illustrative examples.
messages.demo.disclosureText: Organizations, applicants, employees, headcounts, scores, match rates, performance and dates are synthetic and are not actual hiring or evaluation results.
messages.demo.peopleText: All headcounts and sample sizes are synthetic.
messages.demo.scoreText: All scores are synthetic 0–100 examples for understanding the features.
messages.demo.weightText: Separately shows the talent profile combining company evaluation and the potential profile based only on D-CAS/PASS results.
messages.demo.productionText: Replace with report, HR and performance API data, with server-side permissions and audit history.
messages.hiring.filterLabel: Which candidates would you like to view?
messages.hiring.filterHelp: These categories help you find candidates; they are not hiring or rejection decisions.
messages.filterHelp.priority: The applied role and recommended role align, with relatively sufficient supporting evidence.
messages.filterHelp.validate: Confirm the interview, work sample and experience in addition to the test results.
messages.filterHelp.alternate: Another role has a stronger match signal than the applied role.
messages.filterHelp.hold: More information is needed because results are not linked or records are incomplete.
messages.roster.connectDemoHelp: Links the applicant ID in the recruiting system with the D-CAS test ID so the applied role, resume and test results can be viewed together.
messages.modelEvaluation.title: Enter company evaluation
messages.modelEvaluation.help: PASS cognitive traits are fixed from the linked D-CAS report; the company evaluator enters the remaining items.
messages.modelEvaluation.passHelp: Loaded automatically from the report and cannot be edited by the company evaluator.
messages.modelEvaluation.evaluatorHelp: The evaluator enters these three items after reviewing the interview, observed work and work sample.
messages.modelEvaluation.applied: The company evaluation was saved and included in the two-profile comparison.
messages.modelEvaluation.saveFailed: Could not save. Check the server connection and permissions.
messages.modelComparison.title: Compare two talent profiles
messages.modelComparison.help: Compare a profile combining company evaluation with the potential profile based only on D-CAS/PASS results.
messages.modelComparison.integratedHelp: Signal combining the company evaluation for the applied role with assessment results
messages.modelComparison.passOnlyHelp: Recommended role and potential signal from the report without company evaluation
messages.modelComparison.aligned: Both analyses point in a similar direction. Use their shared strengths when reviewing the company talent profile.
messages.modelComparison.review: The analyses differ in some areas. Review the role interview and work-sample evidence together.
messages.modelComparison.gap: The analyses differ substantially. Recheck the company evidence and the applied role.
messages.modelComparison.alignmentHelp: Shows the strengths and role direction shared by both analyses as a 0–100 signal.
messages.modelComparison.priorityInterview: Priority interview review · Explore shared strengths and role evidence in depth
messages.modelComparison.roleReview: In-depth job-family review · Check common and differing areas through interview and work sample
messages.modelComparison.moreEvidence: Gather more evidence · Recheck other job families and company evaluation evidence
